proxyImport.desc: Bulk-import proxies and assign them round-robin to enabled accounts. The scheme (SOCKS5/HTTP) is auto-detected by probing each proxy.
proxyImport.formatHint: Supported: host:port, host:port:user:pass, host:port|user|pass, user:pass@host:port, or a full scheme:// URL.

settings.filterEnvNoiseHint: Removes injected env vars, git status, recent commits and similar noise from system prompts.
settings.filterStripBoundariesHint: Strips --- SYSTEM PROMPT --- / --- END SYSTEM PROMPT --- marker lines.

detail.overageEnabled: Enabled (continues billing at overage rate when quota is exhausted)
detail.overageNotCapable: This subscription does not support Overages
detail.proxyHint: Leave empty to use global proxy. Format: socks5://host:port or http://host:port

apikeyBatch.title: Import API Keys (bulk)
apikeyBatch.desc: Paste a list of Kiro Dev App / AWS API keys, one per line. Each new key becomes an enabled account; duplicates are skipped. Credit (used/limit) is shown per account after import.
apikeyBatch.listHint: One key per line. Blank lines and duplicates are ignored.
apikeyBatch.listRequired: Please paste at least one API key
modal.relayDesc: Add a key from a third-party relay that speaks the Kiro protocol, as a standby when the pool is empty
relay.desc: For third-party Kiro account-sharing services: paste the key they issued along with their endpoint and Host header. No CA certificate to install and no hosts file to edit.
relay.privacyWarn: Every prompt and reply passes through a third party in plaintext — including your customers'. Only use this if that is acceptable to you. Never contribute your own Kiro account credentials to such a service: a refresh token is full control of the account.
relay.keyPlaceholder: Paste the key the relay issued to you
relay.endpointHint: Absolute URL of the streaming call itself, usually ending in /generateAssistantResponse
relay.endpointInvalid: Endpoint must start with http:// or https://
relay.hostHint: Overrides only the Host header; TLS still validates against the endpoint's own host, so no CA has to be installed. Leave empty unless the relay requires it.
relay.priorityHint: Lower tiers are tried first. Leaving this at 99 means the relay only runs once every other account and provider is exhausted — a true standby for an empty pool.
modal.kiroDesc: Sign in with work email through Microsoft Entra ID via Kiro portal
kiro.emailHint: Leave empty to choose from Kiro portal. Use this if you know your organization uses Microsoft Entra.
kiro.browserOpened: Kiro sign-in page opened in your browser
kiro.browserHint: Complete authentication in the browser. The page will close automatically.

apiKeys.listHint: Create multiple keys; each tracks usage and limits independently.
apiKeys.requireHint: When enabled, all /v1/* requests must include Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-Api-Key.
apiKeys.requireWithoutEnabledKeyWarning: No enabled API key found (legacy keys migrated from older configs are kept disabled). Enabling authentication now will reject every /v1/* request. Enable or create a key first — continue anyway?
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet. Click the button on the right to add one.
apiKeys.formKeyEditPlaceholder: Current: {0} — leave blank to keep, or type a new value
apiKeys.modelHint: Tick one or more allowed models. A client model in the list passes through; one not in the list is remapped to the first ticked model. Leave all unticked to accept the client's requested model. The global Force Model setting overrides this.
apiKeys.showWarning: Copy and store this key now. It will not be shown in plaintext again.
settings.publicBaseURLHint: Externally reachable URL of this proxy, e.g. https://azr.hian.software. Used to build OAuth redirect_uri so SSO login works behind a custom domain instead of localhost. Leave empty to auto-detect from the request.
settings.limitNoticeHint: Message sent to a client whose key is disabled, expired, over-limit, or blocked by IP rules. Keep it short: long prose makes coding agents treat it as model output and reason about it. Leave empty to use a per-reason default.
settings.limitNoticeAsError: Report blocked keys as an HTTP error
settings.limitNoticeAsErrorHint: Recommended. Sends 429 (over-limit, with Retry-After), 401 (expired) or 403 (disabled / IP-denied) so clients retry or surface it correctly. Turn off to reply HTTP 200 with the message as an assistant turn instead — that shape makes coding agents mistake it for the model's answer and invent explanations.
settings.forceModelHint: When set, EVERY request is rewritten to this model regardless of what the client sent or which model a key is bound to. Choose "Off" to respect the client's model. Takes effect on the next request.
settings.identityModelHint: When set, a "You are <model>" line is injected into the system prompt so the assistant self-reports as this model when asked, regardless of the real upstream model. Choose "Off" to leave identity to the model's own training. Takes effect on the next request.
settings.identityModelWarn: We devs suffer a lot — please be a dev with a conscience and leave this feature off.
apilog.title: API Request Log
apilog.hint: Recent requests per API key, with tokens and credits consumed each request. In-memory only (last 1000), cleared on restart.
apilog.inUncached: Uncached input tokens (fresh prompt only; cache read/write are shown separately, and In + Cache R + Cache W + Out = Total)
settings.maxPayload: Max payload size (per-request byte cap sent to AWS)
settings.maxPayloadAggressive: 2.1 MB · Aggressive · ~860k tokens · near AWS ~2.15MB limit
settings.maxPayloadMax: 4.0 MB · Max · try ~1M (AWS still blocks ~2.15MB, no safety net)
settings.maxPayloadHint: AWS hard-limits ~2.15MB. Exceeding it = request fails with 400, no retry. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
apiKeys.expiresAtHint: Key stops authenticating after this time. Leave empty to never expire.
apiKeys.rpmLimitHint: Throttles requests per minute by delaying (not rejecting). 0 = unlimited.
apiKeys.ipLimitHint: Max distinct client IPs allowed to use this key at once. 0 = unlimited.
apiKeys.ipAllowlistPlaceholder: One IP or CIDR per line, e.g. 203.0.113.7 or 10.0.0.0/24
apiKeys.ipAllowlistHint: When non-empty, only listed IPs/CIDRs may use this key. One per line.
apiKeys.tpmLimitHint: Tokens-per-minute metadata for reference; not enforced. 0 = unlimited.
apiKeys.confirmResetAll: Reset ALL counters for "{0}", including the lifetime total? This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.boundAccountsHint: This key routes only through the selected account(s). Leave all unchecked to use the shared pool. If none of the bound accounts is usable (cooldown, over quota, or missing the requested model) the request falls back to the shared pool.
apiKeys.boundAccountsEmpty: No accounts available. Add an account first.

maintenance.hint: While maintenance is on, API requests are rejected with this notice. The admin panel stays reachable.
portal.rememberKey: Remember this key on this device
detail.priorityHint: Lower tier is tried first. Accounts and external providers share this scale, so 0 / 1 / 2 lets you interleave them.
providers.title: External Providers
providers.hint: OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible upstreams that serve requests alongside the Kiro pool. Requests are forwarded unchanged, so a provider only handles endpoints that speak its own protocol.
providers.confirmDelete: Delete this provider? Requests will stop being routed to it.
providers.protocolHint: Protocol determines the native endpoint. With the bridge on, the provider also serves the other protocol's endpoint and /v1/responses via translation.
providers.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored key
providers.modelsHint: One per line: client-model = provider-model. Append @ input/output/cacheWrite/cacheRead to override the pricing for that model (credits per 1M tokens). Example: claude-opus-4.8 = glm-4.6 @ 8/80/10/8
providers.priceHint: Order: input, output, cache write, cache read. Charged against the same credit balance customers buy.
providers.priorityHint: Tier is tried in ascending order and is shared with Kiro accounts. Weight splits traffic between providers in the same tier.
providers.allowBridgeHint: Let this provider serve endpoints it does not natively speak, by translating requests and responses. An anthropic provider also serves /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses; an openai provider also serves /v1/messages and /v1/responses. Off by default: passthrough is lossless, translation is best-effort.
autobuy.hint: Buys Kiro keys from kiro-market when the pool runs low. The webhook is the primary path; the polling loop is only a fallback for when delivery fails.
autobuy.enabledHint: Once on, purchases happen unattended within the limits below.
autobuy.dryRunHint: Evaluates every guard and logs the decision without ordering. The only way to verify a policy before trusting it with money.
autobuy.marketKeyHint: The usr-… token. Leaving this blank on save keeps the stored key.
autobuy.webhookSecretHint: Verifies the HMAC signature. Required before enabling: without it, anyone who finds the webhook URL could trigger purchases on your credits.
autobuy.notifyWebhookHint: Receives a POST on a purchase or a failure that will not fix itself. This is the only channel that reaches you while you sleep.
autobuy.zonesHint: The two zones are priced independently (US at 25 while EU is at 10, for instance), so each needs its own price ceiling.
autobuy.minHealthy: Buy when usable accounts fall below
autobuy.minHealthyHint: Counts accounts that can actually serve a request: quota-exhausted and cooling-down ones are excluded. 0 disables this trigger.
autobuy.maxPool: Stop buying once the pool reaches
autobuy.maxPoolHint: A backstop against unbounded growth. 0 means no cap.
autobuy.minBalanceHint: Skips buying when the market balance falls below this floor. 0 spends freely.
autobuy.maxCreditsPerDayHint: The guard that actually bounds financial exposure. The counter is persisted, so a restart does NOT hand back a fresh allowance. 0 means unlimited.
autobuy.scheduleEnabled: Only buy inside a time window
autobuy.scheduleHint: Interpreted in the server's local time. The window gates webhooks too; otherwise it would be decorative, since webhooks are the main buying path.
autobuy.weekdaysHint: Selecting no day means every day. An overnight window (22:00–06:00) counts as one night belonging to the day it opened.
autobuy.pollIntervalHint: At least 30 seconds, as the market requires. This is only the fallback for when webhook delivery fails.
autobuy.defaultRegionHint: Used only when the market omits a key's region. Normally each key's own region is used, since keys are bound to theirs.
autobuy.buyNowConfirm: Buy now with real credits? The order still passes through every configured limit.
autobuy.webhookHint: Paste this URL into the webhook field on kiro-market, then press Test there to verify the signature. This endpoint takes no admin password — it authenticates by HMAC.
autobuy.dryRunResult: Dry run: would buy {0} key(s) at {1} each
autobuy.telegramHint: Sends alerts straight to Telegram. Both the bot token and the chat ID are required; either one alone delivers nothing.
autobuy.telegramTokenHint: From @BotFather, in the form 123456:ABC-DEF… Leaving this blank on save keeps the stored token. Clear both this and the chat ID to switch Telegram off.
autobuy.telegramChatIdHint: A personal ID is a positive number; a group ID starts with a minus sign (-100…). The bot must have been /start-ed by you, or be a member of the group, or Telegram answers "chat not found".
autobuy.telegramApiBaseHint: Only needed where api.telegram.org is blocked and you route through a relay. Blank uses the official host.
autobuy.notifyPoolExhausted: Alert when every account is unavailable
autobuy.notifyPoolExhaustedHint: Fires the moment no account can serve a request — disabled, banned, out of quota, or cooling down. Works independently of auto-buy.
autobuy.poolAlertRepeatHint: This alert is sent more than once because Telegram occasionally drops a message. Sends are 5 seconds apart. Default 3, maximum 10.
autobuy.testNotifyHint: Sends a real message through every configured channel, using the values currently in the form, so you can test before saving.
